frameworks: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 (LLM01: Prompt Injection)
NIST AI 100-2e2025 (Adversarial Machine Learning & Generative AI Threats)
MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems)

direct_prompt_injection.name: Direct Prompt Injection (System Prompt Override / Goal Hijacking)
direct_prompt_injection.description: Attacker directly inputs commands designed to override system prompt instructions, leak internal instructions, or hijack downstream model behavior.

indirect_prompt_injection.name: Indirect Prompt Injection (Data-Driven Poisoning)
indirect_prompt_injection.description: Malicious payload embedded in untrusted external third-party data sources (e.g. uploaded documents, web pages, RAG retrieved chunks, emails) that executes when processed by the LLM.

jailbreak.name: Jailbreak (Persona Adoption, Hypnosis & Safety Constraint Bypass)
jailbreak.description: Adversarial social engineering prompting techniques such as Do Anything Now (DAN), Evil Confidant, or fictional roleplays to bypass safety alignment filters and elicit forbidden responses.

adversarial_obfuscation.name: Adversarial Obfuscation & Evasion (Surface-Form Mutations)
adversarial_obfuscation.description: Syntactic and lexical encoding perturbations intended to bypass shallow keyword/regex filters while preserving semantic attack meaning for the LLM tokenizer.
